title: TikTok Brand Deal
scenario: A small account says you were selected for a teen brand deal and asks for your full address and ID.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: TikTok Brand Deal: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Real youth partnerships involve parent or guardian verification.
